Implemented a complete self-contained C++20 CLI solution in `output/`:

- Build config: [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt)
- Program implementation: [main.cpp](/workspace/output/src/main.cpp)
- Embedded MARC validation rules (generated from `docs/`): [marc_rules.hpp](/workspace/output/src/marc_rules.hpp)

What it supports:

- `inspect`: base64 ISO2709 -> canonical JSON record
- `inspect_marcxml`: MARCXML (`<record>` or single-record `<collection>`) -> canonical JSON record
- `render_iso2709`: canonical JSON record -> base64 ISO2709
- `render_marcxml`: canonical JSON record -> MARCXML
- Structured errors with required codes: `invalid_request`, `invalid_record`, `internal_error`
- Exit codes: `0` / `1` / `2` per your contract
- UTF-8 enforcement for control/data payloads (rejects malformed UTF-8)
- MARC field validation using embedded bibliographic rules (repeatability, indicators, subfield codes), including dynamic handling for 880 linkage behavior

Build command works as requested from `output/`:

```bash
cmake -B build && cmake --build build
```

I also ran end-to-end checks for all four actions plus malformed/error cases (invalid subfield, invalid UTF-8 payload, MARCXML structure/order violations).
